summary: Comprehensive testing of SANDBOX payment gateway, online checkout split, smart invoicing exclusion, auto-debit cron/admin, and frontend card/cart flows. 17/17 backend tests pass; frontend end-to-end (add card → online checkout → /orders redirect) works. Supplier invoices and admin financials still render.

issues: Per-supplier checkout_collected field returned by API is rolled into the 'Collected' total but not surfaced as a distinct label/badge in the UI (minor transparency gap; backend behavior is correct). Consider showing 'Checkout collected: ₾X' as a sub-line to clarify which portion came from paid-at-checkout orders.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Expose 'checkout_collected' as a distinct line in Admin Financials cards so admins can see online-paid commission separately from monthly-invoiced collections.
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py: validate_card correctly enforces Luhn, expiry, CVC; DECLINE_ON_ADD / DECLINE_ON_CHARGE sim behavior matches spec. No raw PAN/CVC stored; only token/brand/last4/exp/name/verified persisted.
server.py:add_card response uses _card_public which exposes only {brand,last4,exp,name,verified} — raw PAN never leaked. Good.

server.py:create_order online branch computes grand_total up front and simulate_charge once per cart (not per-supplier). supplier_payout = total - fee is computed per supplier; payouts ledger record created with method=checkout_card.
do_generate_invoices filters orders by `not o.get('paid_at_checkout')` — correctly excludes checkout-paid orders from monthly invoices (verified: online-paid orders don't accrue to invoice amounts).
admin_financials computes checkout_collected separately and adds it to collected total. Accrued excludes paid_at_checkout orders (verified via test).
do_auto_debit skips not-yet-due invoices and skips suppliers without verified cards. Charge failures call notify() but do NOT raise — endpoint remains 2xx (acceptable: cron should be idempotent-ish).
/api/cron/auto-debit correctly enforces WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET via Bearer check with secrets.compare_digest.
Payouts endpoint 403s retailers correctly; admin sees all.
SANDBOX gateway is clearly labeled and swappable (per spec, Stripe unavailable in Georgia) — intentional, not a bug.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin, cornerstore (seeded card), freshmart (no card seeded, tested full add flow), metro (seeded card), snacknation (overdue+frozen+card for auto-debit).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; test used provided demo users and the SANDBOX test cards (4242… success, 4000000000000002 decline-on-add, 4000000000000341 decline-on-charge).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are serial-only (test_payments_checkout.py mutates frozen state and cards across users). Pytest config forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; override to `-n 0` for this file (serial = -n 0, NOT -p no:xdist per pytest.ini note). SnackNation gets unfrozen after the admin-auto-debit test — subsequent runs re-freeze via mongo in the frozen-supplier test to keep behavior deterministic. The admin financials UI does not surface a distinct 'Checkout collected' label (backend field present under /api/admin/financials). Online checkout, auto-debit cron with WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, decline cards, and freeze enforcement all verified end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. One minor UX suggestion recorded in frontend design_issues.
